name: Dunnet Bay Accommodation
accommodation: Thurdistoft Farmhouse (sleeps 8) and three cottages (each sleeps 4)
dogs: Pet friendly, with a shared dog-walking field
beachAccess: Dunnet Beach is at the end of the road
boardStorage: Secure storage for motorbikes and bikes
confirmedFeatures: Sea views, shared garden with BBQs and firepits, Wi-Fi, pool table in farmhouse
overview: Dunnet Bay Accommodation is four self-catering properties on a working farm at Castletown, with Dunnet Beach at the end of the road. The farmhouse sleeps eight and the three cottages sleep four each. Guests share a sheltered garden with barbecues and firepits, and there is a field for walking dogs.
surfTripFit: The farmhouse suits a group surf trip, and the beach is just down the road.
